description: get a price estimate for sending a small parcel
utterances: how much to post a shoebox across the country
I need to send a package weighing about two kilos to another city and want to compare what the standard and express options would cost.

description: book a courier to collect a parcel from my home
utterances: can someone come grab a box from my place tomorrow
I have three packages ready to go and no car, I'd like to arrange for a driver to swing by my flat and take them.

description: move a booked collection to a different day
utterances: wont be in wednesday can the pickup shift to thursday
I already arranged for the driver to come this Friday afternoon but something has come up, is it possible to push that to early next week?

description: courier never showed up for the booked collection
utterances: waited all day and nobody came for my parcel
I had a driver scheduled between nine and one today, stayed home the whole time, and the box is still sitting in my hallway untouched.

description: find the nearest place to hand in a parcel
utterances: wheres the closest spot i can leave a package with you
I work late so I can't wait around for a driver, is there a shop or locker near the city centre where I can hand over my box myself?

description: ask how to pack a fragile item for shipping
utterances: sending a vase how should i wrap it so it survives
I'm shipping a framed painting with glass to my brother and I'm nervous about it breaking, what kind of box and padding do you recommend?

description: ask whether an item is allowed to be shipped
utterances: can i mail a bottle of perfume or is that banned
I want to send my nephew a portable charger and some lithium batteries for his drone, are those things you will accept in a parcel?

description: print the label for a shipment i already paid for
utterances: booked it online but nothing printed out what do i stick on
I finished paying for the shipment on your website and the confirmation came through, but I can't find where to download the sticker for the box.

description: check the current location of a parcel
utterances: where is my package at right now
My sister sent me a birthday gift through you on Monday, I'd like to see which depot it has reached and when it might get here.

description: tracking has shown no movement for several days
utterances: the status has been stuck on in transit since sunday
The last scan on my shipment was at a sorting hub five days ago and absolutely nothing has been logged since, is it actually still moving?

description: shipment is past its expected delivery date
utterances: it was due tuesday and its now friday
The estimate said the box would reach me by the end of last week, it's now well past that and I need to know a new date.

description: send a parcel already on its way to a different address
utterances: im at my parents this week can it come here instead
The shipment is already out with the courier but I've had to travel unexpectedly, could you divert it to my office across town?

description: keep a parcel at the depot for me to collect
utterances: just keep it at your branch ill swing by and grab it
I'd rather not have the driver attempt my door at all, can the package wait at your local facility until I come in with ID?

description: allow the driver to leave the parcel without a signature
utterances: just pop it behind the bins if im not in
I'm out during working hours every day this week, please tell the driver it's fine to leave the box in the porch or with my neighbour.

description: arrange another attempt after a missed delivery
utterances: found a card on the mat saying you tried what now
The driver came by while I was at the dentist this morning and left a slip, I'd like them to come back tomorrow after five.

description: ask what time the driver will arrive today
utterances: roughly when today should i expect the van
The tracking says out for delivery but I need to pop to the shops, can you give me a narrower slot so I don't miss it?

description: tracking says delivered but nothing has arrived
utterances: app says it was dropped off but theres nothing here
I got a notification at two o'clock claiming the parcel had been handed over, I've been home all day and checked every doorstep and nobody has it.

description: open an investigation into a lost shipment
utterances: its been three weeks i think the thing is gone for good
The package I sent to my cousin never turned up and the tracking has been dead for ages, I want you to formally search for it.

description: file a claim for a parcel that arrived damaged
utterances: box turned up soaked and the contents are ruined
The crate I shipped to a customer arrived with the side caved in and the lamp inside snapped, I want to be compensated for the loss.

description: check progress of a compensation claim already filed
utterances: any news on the payout i asked for last month
I submitted all the photos and the receipt for my broken shipment three weeks ago and haven't heard anything back, where does it stand?

description: parcel was left at the wrong house
utterances: my neighbour two doors down ended up with my box
The photo the driver uploaded shows a red front door and mine is blue, so it's clearly been left at somebody else's property.

description: shipment is stuck in customs clearance
utterances: its been sitting at the border for a week now
My parcel from overseas has shown the same import inspection status for nine days, is there something I need to do to get it released?

description: explain the import charge added to my parcel
utterances: why am i being asked to pay extra before you hand it over
I received a message saying there's a tax and handling fee owed on my package from abroad, I'd like a breakdown of what that's for.

description: ask which paperwork is needed for an international shipment
utterances: sending gifts abroad what forms do i fill in
I'm mailing some handmade clothing to a friend overseas for the first time and I don't know what declaration or invoice has to go with it.

description: parcel is being sent back to the sender
utterances: tracking says its heading back to the shop why
I never refused anything and was home most of the week, yet the status now shows my package going back to where it came from.

description: get a quote for moving pallets or heavy freight
utterances: how much to shift two pallets of tiles across the country
My workshop needs to send a crated machine weighing roughly four hundred kilos to a client, what would a forklift-to-forklift job like that cost?

description: open a business shipping account with bulk discounts
utterances: we ship fifty boxes a week can we get a trade deal
I run a small online shop and I'm tired of paying counter prices for every parcel, how do I set up a commercial arrangement with monthly billing?

description: add insurance cover to a shipment
utterances: its worth a lot can i protect it in case it breaks
I'm shipping a vintage camera to a buyer and want to make sure I'd be reimbursed for the full value if it goes missing or gets crushed.

description: get proof that a parcel was delivered and signed for
utterances: can you show me who signed for it
My customer insists they never got the package but the tracking says it was handed over, I need the signature and time stamp to settle this.

description: cancel a shipment that has not been collected yet
utterances: dont need to send it anymore can i call the whole thing off
I booked a delivery for tomorrow but the buyer has backed out, the parcel is still here with me so I'd like to void the booking.

description: complain about how the courier behaved
utterances: your guy literally threw the box over my gate
The person delivering today was rude to my elderly mother and left tyre marks on the lawn, I want this reported to someone in charge.

description: dispute a charge on my shipping invoice
utterances: you billed me twice for the same parcel last month
My monthly statement includes a surcharge for a residential delivery that actually went to a warehouse, I'd like that line item corrected.
